name: Scooty
summary: From Booty Bay’s busy pirate port, Scooty keeps a teleport link to Gnomeregan. The goblin engineer trusts his craft and his transponders, though the experimental pad lies in the fallen gnome city. For the Horde, his device opens a perilous route into Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Booty Bay's Teleportation Expert
sections.body: Among Booty Bay’s wharves and workshops, Scooty pursues ambitious tinkering for the Steamwheedle Cartel. While many goblins favor gunpowder and explosives, he works to move matter across great distances. His transponders keep a working link to a teleportation pad inside Gnomeregan. Horde forces rely on his craft to reach the subterranean gnome stronghold without crossing dangerous Alliance territory.

sections.title: Gnomish Gadgets and Goblin Risk
sections.body: Experimental goblin teleporters rarely run without a hitch. After hearing of a new gnomish rig in Gnomeregan, Scooty and his partner Sovik built the Transpolyporter 6000. Scooty cheerfully admits it has exploded a dozen or so times. Crossing continents as scattered matter carries clear physical dangers, yet Scooty remains sure of his genius. To him, every mechanical failure is a small obstacle on the road to innovation.

faq.answer: Scooty works as a goblin engineer in Booty Bay and claims to be a master engineer. He maintains and calibrates the Goblin Transponder network, which links the port to an experimental teleportation pad deep inside Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Why does Scooty have a teleporter to Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Scooty linked Booty Bay to an experimental teleportation pad inside Gnomeregan to allow direct travel into the gnome city. For the Horde, it offers an indispensable route into Dun Morogh without crossing the heavily fortified Alliance homelands.
Scooty works in Booty Bay, the neutral goblin port at the southern tip of Stranglethorn Vale.
Scooty’s teleporter successfully sends adventurers into Gnomeregan, but its workings can go awry. Mechanical mishaps and miscalibrated transponders make each trip a hazard.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can use Scooty’s indispensable shortcut into Gnomeregan to bypass Alliance defenses in Dun Morogh.
As an engineer, you can appreciate Scooty’s audacious use of transponder physics, though goblin disregard for safety makes every activation a gamble.
